cats.metaDesc: Find a videographer in Kazakhstan: reels, ads, music videos, events. Post your task on ChikChirik — videographers with portfolios will respond.
cats.lead: Find a videographer for your task — from social media reels to a commercial. Describe your task on ChikChirik and videographers with portfolios will send you responses. Choose by their work and agree on the details in chat. Videographers work in Almaty, Astana, Shymkent and other cities of Kazakhstan.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a videographer
services: Reels and short videos for social media
Product and service videos for websites and marketplaces
cats.priceTitle: How much does a videographer cost
cats.priceText: The creator sets the price, and you state your budget in the task — so you can see right away who is ready to work within it. The price depends on:
priceFactors: shoot duration and number of locations
whether editing, colour grading and music are needed
how many videos and in which formats — vertical or horizontal
equipment: cameras, lighting, drone, gimbal
deadlines: rush orders usually cost more
tips: Look at work in a similar genre: filming an event and a commercial are different skills.
Check what the price includes: editing, number of revisions, raw footage.
Agree on the delivery date and file formats in advance.
Put agreements in writing in the chat and don’t pay the full amount before work starts.

faq.q: How do I find a videographer on ChikChirik?
faq.a: Download the app and describe your task: what to film, where, when and your budget. Videographers will respond — you just choose by portfolio.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the videographer.

faq.q: Do videographers work outside Almaty and Astana?
faq.a: Most specialists are based in Almaty and Astana, but many work across Kazakhstan.

faq.q: Do I need a separate video editor?
faq.a: Many videographers edit their own footage — ask in the chat. If you only need existing footage edited, look for a video editor.

faq.q: How much does a videographer cost?
faq.a: The videographer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. The cost depends on shoot length, editing, equipment and deadline. Market benchmarks are in our blog article on creative service prices.

faq.q: Can I find a videographer for a wedding or toi?
faq.a: Yes. In the task, give the date, city, duration and what you need as a result — a film, a clip or reels. Videographers will reply with examples of their wedding work.

cats.metaDesc: Find a mobile content creator: reels, stories and business content shot on a phone. Post your task on ChikChirik — creators across Kazakhstan will respond.
cats.lead: Need reels, stories or regular social media content? A mobile content creator (mobilographer) shoots and edits video on a smartphone — fast and in vertical format from the start. Describe your task on ChikChirik and creators will send responses with examples of their videos. Creators work across Kazakhstan — in Almaty, Astana, Shymkent and other cities.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a mobile content creator
services: Reels and short videos for Instagram and TikTok
Stories and content for daily posting
Shoots for cafes, restaurants, shops and salons
Unboxings, product reviews and marketplace videos
Expert videos: talking head, interviews, tips
Event coverage in social media format
Video ideas, scripts and a shooting plan
Phone editing with music, titles and subtitles
Weddings, toi and uzatu in reels format
cats.priceTitle: How much does a mobile content creator cost
cats.priceText: The creator sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. For more accurate responses, say how many videos you need, for which platform and who writes the scripts. Market benchmarks are in our article on creative service prices. The price depends on:
priceFactors: how many videos are needed per visit
whether a script and content ideas are needed
whether editing, music and captions are included
travel to the location and shooting time
whether models, props or a rented space are needed
a one-off shoot or regular content
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose a mobile content creator
tips: Look at reels in your niche — cafes, beauty and retail are filmed differently.
Check who comes up with the scripts and how many videos you’ll get per visit.
Ask what you’ll receive: finished videos, raw footage, covers.
Agree on editing deadlines and the number of revisions.
For regular content, start with one visit — it shows the style and speed.
Put agreements in writing in the chat and don’t pay the full amount before work starts.

faq.q: Mobile content creator or videographer — which do I need?
faq.a: For quick social media content, a mobile content creator works well. For a commercial, a music video or a shoot with a camera and lighting, choose a videographer.

faq.q: Do I need a script?
faq.a: It helps. Many creators help with ideas and scripts — ask in the chat.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the creator.

faq.q: Can I order regular content?
faq.a: Yes, many creators film content on an ongoing basis — for example, several visits a month.

faq.q: How many videos are filmed per visit?
faq.a: It depends on the format and scripts: simple videos are filmed in batches, complex ones one at a time. Say in the task how many videos you need, and the creator will tell you how long it will take.

faq.q: How do I find a mobile content creator in Astana, Almaty or another city?
faq.a: Describe your task on ChikChirik and include the city and shooting address. Creators who are ready to come to the location will respond.

faq.q: What should I prepare for the shoot?
faq.a: Ideas or examples of videos you like, the product or dishes, a tidy location and a person who will be on camera. If you don’t have scripts, ask the creator to suggest them in advance.

faq.q: What does a mobile videographer do?
faq.a: Shoots and edits smartphone video in social media formats: reels, stories, unboxings, expert videos. Often helps with ideas and scripts and delivers clips on the day of the shoot or the next day.

faq.q: How much does a mobile videographer cost?
faq.a: The mobile videographer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. It depends on how many clips per shoot, scripting, editing and whether it's a one-off shoot or regular content. Market benchmarks are in our blog article on creative service prices.

cats.imgAlt: A video editor working on a video
cats.name: Video editors
cats.metaTitle: Video editor — order reels and YouTube editing | ChikChirik
cats.metaDesc: Find a video editor: reels, YouTube, ads, music videos. Post your task on ChikChirik — editors with portfolios will respond. They work remotely.
cats.lead: Editing for reels, YouTube videos, ads and music videos. Describe your task on ChikChirik — video editors will send responses with portfolios. Editing is usually done remotely, so your city doesn’t matter.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a video editor
services: Re-cutting existing videos for different social networks
cats.priceTitle: How much does video editing cost
cats.priceText: The editor sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. The price depends on:
priceFactors: video length and amount of raw footage
complexity: cuts, effects, graphics, colour grading
whether subtitles, music and sound work are needed
number of versions and formats
deadlines and number of revisions
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose a video editor
tips: Look at work in the format you need — editing reels and YouTube videos is different.
Send an example of a video you like — it makes it easier to match the style.
Agree on the number of revisions in advance.
Clarify how you’ll share the footage and in what form you’ll get the result.

faq.q: Can I work with a video editor remotely?
faq.a: Yes, editing is almost always done remotely: you share the footage via a link and discuss revisions in chat.

faq.q: What do I need to get started?
faq.a: The raw footage, an example of the result you want, the length and format of the video, the deadline and your budget.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of editing directly with the creator.

faq.q: Can a video editor also film?
faq.a: Some editors film too — ask in the chat. If you need a shoot, check out videographers.

faq.q: What does a video editor do?
faq.a: Assembles a video from footage and adds music, titles, subtitles and colour correction. Many editors also adapt one video for different platforms: reels, YouTube and ads.

faq.q: How much does video editing cost?
faq.a: The editor sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. It depends on video length, amount of footage, graphics, colour correction and deadline. Market benchmarks are in our blog article on creative service prices.

cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a drone operator
services: Aerial footage of real estate and residential complexes
Events, weddings and concerts from above
Construction progress and sites over time
Aerial photos and videos for websites and social media
cats.priceTitle: How much does aerial filming cost
cats.priceText: The operator sets the price, and you state your budget in the task — so you can see right away who is ready to work within it. The price depends on:
priceFactors: flight time and number of locations
photos, video or both
editing and colour grading
travel outside the city
flight approvals for the area
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose a drone operator
tips: Look at work in a similar format: real estate, events and ads are filmed differently.
Check who is responsible for flight permissions — flights are restricted in some areas.
Agree on a backup date in case of wind or rain.
Put agreements in writing in the chat and don’t pay the full amount before work starts.

faq.q: Are flight permissions needed?
faq.a: Flights are restricted in some areas — for example, near airports and government sites. Agree with the operator before the shoot on who handles approvals.

faq.q: What if the weather turns bad?
faq.a: Drones don’t fly in strong wind or rain, so it’s best to agree on a backup date right away.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the shoot directly with the operator.

faq.q: Can the operator edit the video?
faq.a: Many drone operators edit their own footage — ask in the chat. If you only need editing, look for a video editor.

faq.q: How much does drone filming cost?
faq.a: The operator sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. It depends on flight time, location and travel, whether you need photos, video and editing, and flight permissions at the location.

cats.imgAlt: A photographer on a shoot for a client
cats.name: Photographers
cats.metaTitle: Photographer in Kazakhstan — photo shoots | ChikChirik
cats.metaDesc: Need a photographer? Photo shoots, product photography, events, business portraits. Post your task on ChikChirik — photographers across Kazakhstan respond.
cats.lead: Need a photographer for a photo shoot, an event or product photos? Describe your task on ChikChirik — professional and freelance photographers across Kazakhstan will send responses with their portfolios. Choose by their work and agree on the details in chat.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a photographer
services: Photo shoots: portrait, family, love story — in a studio or on location
Business portraits for websites, CVs and social media
Product photography for websites, Kaspi and marketplaces
Children's, newborn and maternity photo shoots
cats.priceTitle: How much does a photographer cost
cats.priceText: The photographer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task — so you can see right away who is ready to work within it. For more accurate responses, mention the type of shoot, how many final photos you need and the date. The price depends on:
priceFactors: the type of shoot: product, portrait or reportage
the length of the shoot and the number of shots
retouching: how many photos and how deep the editing is
studio rental, lighting and props
travel to the location
the delivery deadline
tips: Look at portfolios in the genre you need: product, portrait and reportage photography are different skills.
Ask to see a full series from one shoot, not just the best shots.
Check how many photos you will get, how many will be retouched and when.
Discuss whether the photographer has their own lighting and studio or they need to be rented.
Agree where and how the photos can be used — for example, in advertising.
Put the agreements in the chat and don't pay the full amount upfront before the shoot.

faq.q: How do I find a photographer on ChikChirik?
faq.a: Download the app and describe your task: what to shoot, where, when and your budget. Photographers will respond — you just choose by portfolio.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the shoot directly with the photographer.

faq.q: Who pays for the studio?
faq.a: That’s agreed with the photographer: sometimes rental is included in the price, sometimes it’s paid separately. Ask in the chat before the shoot.

faq.q: Can I use the photos in ads?
faq.a: You and the photographer agree on usage rights yourselves — settle this in advance and put it in writing in the chat.

faq.q: How do I find a freelance photographer in my city?
faq.a: Describe your task on ChikChirik and specify the city. Photographers who work there or are ready to travel will respond — each has a portfolio and reviews in their profile.

faq.q: How should I prepare for a photo shoot?
faq.a: Decide on the purpose and the look, collect 3–5 reference images and discuss the location, clothes and time with the photographer. The more detailed the task, the more accurate the responses.

faq.q: When will the photos be ready?
faq.a: It depends on the number of shots and how deep the retouching is — the photographer will name the deadline in their response. If you need the photos by a certain date, put it in the task right away.

faq.q: How much does a photographer cost?
faq.a: The photographer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. It depends on shoot length, number of edited photos, studio rental and travel. Market benchmarks are in our blog article on creative service prices.

cats.imgAlt: A motion designer working on an animation
cats.name: Motion designers
cats.metaTitle: Motion design — order animation and videos | ChikChirik
cats.metaDesc: Find a motion designer: logo animation, graphics for ads and social media, explainer videos. Post your task on ChikChirik — designers will respond.
cats.lead: Logo animation, graphics for ads and social media, explainer videos and titles. Describe your task on ChikChirik — motion designers will send responses with their showreels. They work remotely across Kazakhstan.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a motion designer
services: Titles, lower thirds and video graphics
cats.priceTitle: How much does motion design cost
cats.priceText: The designer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. The price depends on:
priceFactors: video length
2D or 3D
whether a script and storyboard are needed
style complexity and number of elements
deadlines and number of revisions
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose a motion designer
tips: Look at a showreel in the style you need — minimalism, characters and 3D require different skills.
Send references, your logo and brand colours.
Approve the storyboard before animation starts — it means fewer revisions.
Clarify which formats you’ll receive and whether source files are included.

faq.q: What do I need to get started?
faq.a: The purpose of the video, its length, references, your logo and brand colours, the deadline and your budget.

faq.q: Can I order just an animation storyboard?
faq.a: Yes. Storyboards are often ordered separately to agree on the idea, estimate the budget or hand over to an animator. The stages are covered in our blog article on ordering a motion video.

faq.q: What’s the difference between a motion designer and a video editor?
faq.a: A video editor assembles a video from filmed footage, while a motion designer creates animation and graphics from scratch.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the designer.

faq.q: Will I get the source files?
faq.a: That’s agreed with the designer. Settle in advance which files and formats you’ll receive.

faq.q: How much does motion design cost?
faq.a: The designer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. The biggest factors are length, 2D or 3D, the number of scenes, and whether you need a script, storyboard and voice-over. The stages are covered in our blog article on ordering a motion video.

cats.imgAlt: A graphic designer working on a layout
cats.name: Designers
cats.metaTitle: Graphic designers in Kazakhstan — logo, branding | ChikChirik
cats.metaDesc: Find a graphic designer: logo, branding, social media design, presentations, packaging. Post your task on ChikChirik — designers will respond.
cats.lead: Need a logo, a brand identity, social media or packaging design? Describe your task on ChikChirik — graphic designers and illustrators will send responses with their portfolios. Designers from Almaty, Astana and other cities work remotely across Kazakhstan.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from a designer
services: Posts, stories and cover design for social media
Product cards for Kaspi and marketplaces
cats.priceTitle: How much does a designer cost
cats.priceText: The designer sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. For more accurate responses, attach examples and describe what you need to receive in the end. The price depends on:
priceFactors: scope: a single layout or a full brand identity
number of concepts and revisions
whether source files and usage rights are included
complexity: illustration, animation, print
deadlines
how many formats to adapt: social media, website, print
tips: Look at portfolios in the right area: logos, social media and packaging are different tasks.
Ask to see the process — sketches and options, not just final work.
Send examples you like and describe the brand's audience.
Agree on the number of options and revisions in advance.
For a logo, check whether there will be versions for dark backgrounds, an icon and social media.
Check which files you will receive and whether the source files are included.

faq.q: How do I write a brief for a designer?
faq.a: Describe what needs to be done, who the brand is for, which colours and style you like, attach examples and state the deadline and budget.

faq.q: Will I get the source files?
faq.a: That’s agreed with the designer. Settle in advance which files and formats you’ll receive.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the designer.

faq.q: Can I work with a designer from another city?
faq.a: Yes, designers usually work remotely: discussion and revisions happen in the chat.

faq.q: How much does a logo cost?
faq.a: It depends on the complexity and whether you need just a mark or a full brand identity. State your budget in the task — designers will offer their terms in their responses.

faq.q: How many revisions are included?
faq.a: Each designer sets the number of revisions. Discuss it in advance and put it in the chat together with the number of options.

faq.q: Who owns the rights to the logo?
faq.a: Usage rights and the handover of source files are discussed with the designer. For a logo, it's better to agree on a full transfer of rights in advance.

faq.q: What does a graphic designer do?
faq.a: Creates visuals for business: logos and brand identity, social media design, marketplace product cards, presentations, packaging and ads. Many designers specialise in one or two areas — look at portfolios in the format you need.

cats.imgAlt: An AI creator making content with neural networks
cats.name: AI creators
cats.metaTitle: AI Creator in Kazakhstan — AI Video & Photos | ChikChirik
cats.metaDesc: Order AI video, product photos without a shoot, avatars and social media visuals. Describe your task on ChikChirik — AI creators reply with examples of their work.
cats.lead: An AI creator makes video, photos and visuals with neural networks: an ad without a film crew, a product photo in any interior, a talking avatar or a series of images for social media. Describe your task on ChikChirik and AI creators will reply with examples of their work. Specialists work remotely across Kazakhstan.
cats.servicesTitle: What you can order from an AI creator
services: AI video and ads without a shoot
Product photos in any interior or scene — for marketplaces and websites
AI avatars and talking characters for reels and training videos
Visuals, illustrations and covers for social media
Concepts and moodboards before a big shoot
Bringing photos to life and animating images
AI voice-over, video translation into Kazakh and English, and music
AI photo shoots from your own photos — for social media and gifts
cats.priceTitle: How much does an AI creator cost
cats.priceText: The creator sets the price, and you state your budget in the task. For more accurate replies, say how many images or seconds of video you need, where the result will be used and whether you have references. The price depends on:
priceFactors: number of images or video length
scene complexity and how many variations you need
whether manual work is needed: retouching, editing, compositing
paid tools and computing power the creator uses
rights to use the result in advertising
deadline
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose an AI creator
tips: Look at examples in your exact format: video, product photos or characters.
Ask to see a before-and-after: the original product photo and the result.
Describe the style and send references, your logo and brand colours.
Ask which tools are used and whether the result can be used in ads.
If a real person appears, you need their consent to use their likeness and voice.
Agree on the number of variations and revisions, and start with a small test task.

faq.q: What can I order from an AI creator?
faq.a: AI video for ads and social media, product photos, avatars and characters, illustrations, photo and video enhancement, voice-over and translation.

faq.q: When should I choose an AI creator?
faq.a: When you need visuals quickly without a shoot: concepts, product backgrounds, unusual scenes. For real people and real locations, a photographer or videographer is usually a better fit.

faq.q: Can I get marketplace product photos without a shoot?
faq.a: Yes, it's one of the most common orders: the creator places the product into the interior or scene you need, based on one or several source photos. Check that the shape, colour and labels are accurate, and confirm the marketplace's photo requirements in advance.

faq.q: Can AI content be used in ads?
faq.a: It depends on the tools the creator uses and your agreement. Discuss the rights to the result in advance.

faq.q: Do I need consent if someone's face or voice is in the video?
faq.a: Yes. Use a person's likeness and voice only with their consent, ideally in writing. This applies to employees and hired models alike.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the creator.

faq.q: Can the result be refined?
faq.a: Yes, creators usually do several iterations — agree on the number of revisions in advance.

cats.priceTitle: How much do SMM services cost

priceFactors: how many social networks and posts per month

a one-off task or ongoing management
the specialist’s experience in your niche
whether copywriting, design and editing are needed
cats.tipsTitle: How to choose an SMM specialist
tips: Ask for case studies with numbers: reach, followers, leads.
Look at experience in your niche.
Agree on goals and the report format.
Ask which metrics the specialist considers success and how often they will report.
Don't share account passwords — give access through roles in Meta Business Suite.
Start with a one-off task or a trial month.

faq.q: What’s the difference between an SMM specialist and a targeting specialist?
faq.a: An SMM specialist runs social media and creates content; a targeting specialist sets up paid ads. Many do both — ask in the chat.

faq.q: Can I order a one-off task?
faq.a: Yes: a content plan, a profile audit or an ad launch can be ordered separately from ongoing management.

faq.q: How much does it cost to post a task?
faq.a: Posting a task and receiving responses is free. You agree on the price of the work directly with the specialist.

faq.q: Do SMM specialists work remotely?
faq.a: Most do, across Kazakhstan. If you need content shot, look for a specialist in your city.

faq.q: How do I find an SMM specialist for my business?
faq.a: Describe your task on ChikChirik: your niche, social networks, goals and budget. Specialists will send responses with case studies — choose those with experience in your field.

faq.q: How much does an SMM specialist cost?
faq.a: It depends on the scope: a one-off service, running one network or a package with ads. See our article on creative service prices for reference; specialists will name the exact price in their responses.

faq.q: What should I give an SMM specialist to start?
faq.a: Access to accounts through roles, a description of the business and audience, the photos and videos you already have, and examples of accounts you like.

faq.q: What does an SMM specialist do?
faq.a: Runs a business's social media: strategy and content plan, creating or commissioning content, writing posts, replying to the audience and tracking results. An SMM specialist often runs ads too — or works alongside a targeting specialist.
